cfg.EDGE:
!
version 15.1
no service timestamps log datetime msec
no service timestamps debug datetime msec
no service password-encryption
!
hostname Router
!
!
!
!
ip dhcp excluded-address 192.168.10.1 192.168.10.9
ip dhcp excluded-address 192.168.20.1 192.168.20.9
ip dhcp excluded-address 192.168.30.1 192.168.30.9
!
ip dhcp pool STAFF
 network 192.168.10.0 255.255.255.0
 default-router 192.168.10.1
 dns-server 192.168.50.10
ip dhcp pool ENG
 network 192.168.20.0 255.255.255.0
 default-router 192.168.20.1
 dns-server 192.168.50.10
ip dhcp pool GUEST
 network 192.168.30.0 255.255.255.0
 default-router 192.168.30.1
 dns-server 8.8.8.8
!
!
!
no ip cef
no ipv6 cef
!
!
!
username netadmin privilege 15 secret 5 $1$mERr$RdfL86GsP/7paITZzvPtO1
!
!
license udi pid CISCO2911/K9 sn FTX15249U4Q-
!
!
!
!
!
!
!
!
!
!
!
ip ssh version 2
ip domain-name corp.local
!
!
spanning-tree mode pvst
!
!
!
!
!
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/0
 description to ISP
 ip address 198.51.100.2 255.255.255.248
 ip nat outside
 duplex auto
 speed auto
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/1
 description to CORE
 ip address 10.0.0.1 255.255.255.252
 ip nat inside
 duplex auto
 speed auto
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/2
 no ip address
 duplex auto
 speed auto
!
interface Serial0/0/0
 description WAN to BR
 ip address 10.0.0.5 255.255.255.252
 ip nat inside
 clock rate 128000
!
interface Serial0/0/1
 no ip address
 clock rate 2000000
!
interface Vlan1
 no ip address
!
router ospf 1
 router-id 1.1.1.1
 log-adjacency-changes
 network 10.0.0.0 0.0.0.3 area 0
 network 10.0.0.4 0.0.0.3 area 0
 default-information originate
!
ip nat inside source list 1 interface GigabitEthernet0/0 overload
ip nat inside source static 192.168.50.10 198.51.100.5 
ip classless
ip route 0.0.0.0 0.0.0.0 198.51.100.1 
!
ip flow-export version 9
!
!
access-list 1 permit 192.168.0.0 0.0.255.255
access-list 1 permit 172.16.0.0 0.0.255.255
access-list 1 permit 10.0.0.0 0.0.0.255
!
!
!
!
!
line con 0
!
line aux 0
!
line vty 0 4
 login local
 transport input ssh
line vty 5 15
 login local
 transport input ssh
!
!
!
end

cfg.CORE:
!
version 12.2(37)SE1
no service timestamps log datetime msec
no service timestamps debug datetime msec

!

!
!
no profinet

!
!

!
interface FastEthernet0/1
 switchport access vlan 50
 switchport mode access
 spanning-tree portfast
!
interface FastEthernet0/2
!
interface FastEthernet0/3
!
interface FastEthernet0/4
!
interface FastEthernet0/5
!
interface FastEthernet0/6
!

!
interface FastEthernet0/13
!
interface FastEthernet0/14
!
interface FastEthernet0/15
!
interface FastEthernet0/16
!
interface FastEthernet0/17
!
interface FastEthernet0/18
!
interface FastEthernet0/19
!
interface FastEthernet0/20
!
interface FastEthernet0/21
!
interface FastEthernet0/22
!
interface FastEthernet0/23
!
interface FastEthernet0/24
 switchport trunk allowed vlan 10,20,30,50
 switchport trunk encapsulation dot1q
 switchport mode trunk
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/1
 description uplink EDGE
 no switchport
 ip address 10.0.0.2 255.255.255.252
 duplex auto
 speed auto
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/2
 switchport trunk allowed vlan 10,20,30,50
 switchport trunk encapsulation dot1q
 switchport mode trunk
!
interface Vlan1
 no ip address
 shutdown
!
interface Vlan10
 mac-address 00d0.bc06.de01
 ip address 192.168.10.1 255.255.255.0
 ip helper-address 10.0.0.1
!
interface Vlan20
 mac-address 00d0.bc06.de02
 ip address 192.168.20.1 255.255.255.0
 ip helper-address 10.0.0.1
!
interface Vlan30
 mac-address 00d0.bc06.de03
 ip address 192.168.30.1 255.255.255.0
 ip helper-address 10.0.0.1
!
interface Vlan50
 mac-address 00d0.bc06.de04
 ip address 192.168.50.1 255.255.255.0
!
router ospf 1
 router-id 2.2.2.2
 log-adjacency-changes
 passive-interface Vlan10
 passive-interface Vlan20
 passive-interface Vlan30
 passive-interface Vlan50
 network 10.0.0.0 0.0.0.3 area 0
 network 192.168.10.0 0.0.0.255 area 0
 network 192.168.20.0 0.0.0.255 area 0
 network 192.168.30.0 0.0.0.255 area 0
 network 192.168.50.0 0.0.0.255 area 0
!
ip classless
!
ip flow-export version 9
!
!
ip access-list extended GUEST-ISOLATE
 deny ip 192.168.30.0 0.0.0.255 192.168.10.0 0.0.0.255
 deny ip 192.168.30.0 0.0.0.255 192.168.20.0 0.0.0.255
 deny ip 192.168.30.0 0.0.0.255 192.168.50.0 0.0.0.255
 deny ip 192.168.30.0 0.0.0.255 172.16.0.0 0.0.255.255
 permit ip any any
!
!
!
!
!
!
line con 0
!
line aux 0
!
line vty 0 4
 login
!
!
!
!
end
